config.label: Hostname or IP of the Asterisk server
config.description: Hostname or IP of the Asterisk server. Set this to enable the Asterisk tools.

config.label: Asterisk Manager Interface port
config.description: Asterisk Manager Interface port. Defaults to 5038.

config.label: Connect to AMI over TLS
config.description: Connect to AMI over TLS. Set true if tlsenable=yes in manager.conf.

config.label: Hostname or IP of the FreeSWITCH server
config.description: Hostname or IP of the FreeSWITCH server. Set this to enable the FreeSWITCH tools.

config.label: FreeSWITCH inbound event socket port
config.description: FreeSWITCH inbound event socket port. Defaults to 8021.

config.label: Event socket password from event_socket
config.description: Event socket password from event_socket.conf.xml. Defaults to ClueCon, which you should change.

config.label: Unlocks call control
config.description: Unlocks call control. When false the server is read-only and the originate and hangup tools are not registered at all. Placing a call on a live trunk costs real money, so leave this off unless you mean it.

config.label: Per command timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per command timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
